product.olivetti-m15-plus.summary: 1988 80C88 portable with 512 KB, a detachable keyboard, a backlit monochrome LCD and dual-floppy or 20 MB HDU configurations.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.history: The M15 Plus is a distinct successor within Olivetti's M15 portable family. It combined an 80C88 at 4.77 MHz, 512 KB, a detachable keyboard and a 10.5-inch backlit LCD. Olivetti sold either two internal 720 KB floppy drives or one floppy with a 20 MB HDU; both configurations are represented experimentally.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.warning: EXPERIMENTAL: POST, resets, 512 KB, original media boot and documented display modes are validated. The new 20 MB HDU uses the BIOS-observed host contract and still requires complete original-diagnostic validation; exact LCD response and remaining board logic are approximate.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.creation.varia: One internal 720 KB floppy drive and 20 MB HDU
product.olivetti-m15-plus.creation.note: Olivetti sold both configurations and both can be created experimentally. The optional external 360 KB drive is not represented.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.creation.hdu_n: The 20 MB HDU profile creates one 720 KB floppy and one 615/4/17 disk behind the integrated adapter at ports 320h-323h, IRQ 5 and DMA 3. Olivetti labels the physical drive interface SCSI; BluMach reuses an XTA-compatible host state machine because that is the contract observed by BIOS 1.10.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.cpu_: Intel 80C88 at 4.77 MHz with 512 KB user RAM. The available emulator core and calibrated timer remain timing approximations.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.vide: Backlit super-twist monochrome LCD. The original utility names black, six grey levels and white; the Plus renderer preserves those eight levels with an approximate luminance curve. The guide documents 40/80-column text and 320×200/640×200 graphics; a brochure's conflicting 640×320 claim is not exposed as an emulated mode.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.swit: BIOS 1.10 decodes the same multiplexed memory and 40/80-column startup bits as M15. Memory is fixed at the documented 512 KB; Configure exposes only the firmware-backed startup text choice.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.firm: Local BIOS 1.10: 32 KB mapped at F8000h-FFFFFh, reset date 06/03/88. It remains local-only pending provenance and rights verification.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.impl: The model reuses the evidence-backed M15-family board-switch, MSM6242 RTC and V6355D paths while preserving a separate identity and 32 KB firmware map. Its dedicated HDU/SCSI device reuses the XTA host state machine for the BIOS-observed 320h-323h, IRQ 5 and DMA 3 contract, including buffer and long-sector diagnostic commands.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.stat: Cold boot and both reset paths pass Resident Diagnostics and report 512/512 KB. Original media boots under MS-DOS 3.20; its configuration report identifies both internal 720 KB drives. The customer Memory, System Board and Display LCD tests pass, validating the character set, attributes, eight ordered shades and 320×200/640×200 graphics.
product.olivetti-m15-plus.technical.limi: The HDU host contract is implemented, but the unidentified physical SCSI bridge, drive firmware and stored ECC bytes are approximated; raw disk images synthesize the four diagnostic ECC bytes. Exact LCD response, timer calibration and remaining custom board logic also remain approximate.
